review.brief: Change jbh-iam-api-add-opentelemetry-observability (JBH-58, JBH-55 section 4). Diff: git diff 45f9c93...HEAD. User decisions: D1 OTEL_SDK_DISABLED gates ONLY OTLP export (management.otlp.tracing/logging.export.enabled), tracing stays on in every profile incl. prod; default export off. Fixed names: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT (default http://localhost:14317, gRPC), OTEL_SDK_DISABLED, OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG, JBH_ENV, JBH_SERVICE_VERSION (default unknown). Gateway client must get the Spring OpenTelemetry bean (GlobalOpenTelemetry never read). Shared 11 SLO buckets. No unit tests (plan rule); test_first skipped. No DB change. Task 4.1 doc edit (.claude/CLAUDE.md) is untracked and kept local by user decision D8: read it on disk, do not expect it in the diff. Security-Gate: skip (user decision D7). Still check by normal lenses: no secrets/tokens/emails in logs, span attributes or metric tags; AuthorizationRules unchanged; Spring Security only in jbh-iam-security. Manual checks M1-M12 are the user's, not run.
